versions.changelog:
- Initial release of mcpglue, a native OpenClaw MCP bridge framework inspired by Claude Code MCPTool.
- Enables stdio/SSE protocol connections to external services, supporting dynamic tool registration, resource access, and streamed responses.
- Pure original implementation using the open-source @modelcontextprotocol/sdk library; no leaked code.
- Includes Python client scripts for listing and calling MCP tools via Node.js servers.
- Suitable for database access, GitHub API operations, file system interactions, and custom API integration through MCP.
